## Try It Out!
### Revoke Sharetribe transaction rights after completed transaction

Implement a pay-per-lead or pay-per-use model by automatically revoking a user's ability to initiate transactions after they complete one. Users must pay again to regain access.

### How it works
* The Sharetribe Trigger polls for `transaction/transitioned` events.
* An IF node filters for the `transition/confirm-payment` transition.
* The Update Permissions action removes the user's transaction initiation rights.

### How to set up
1. Connect your Sharetribe credentials (Client ID and Client Secret from Console > Build > Applications).
2. Enable "Restrict transaction rights" in Console > Build > General.
3. Update the transition name if your process uses a different confirmation transition.
4. Activate the workflow.

### Requirements
* Sharetribe marketplace with Integration API credentials
* Transaction rights restriction enabled in marketplace settings

### How to customize
* Pair with the "Grant permissions after Stripe payment" workflow to create a complete pay-per-lead cycle.
* Add a counter using extended data to allow N transactions before revoking.
* Add a Gmail notification to inform the user their rights have been used.
* Filter by transaction process name to only apply to specific listing types.

Need help? Visit the [n8n Community](https://community.n8n.io/) or [Sharetribe Docs](https://www.sharetribe.com/docs/).

## 1. Listen for transitions
Polls for `transaction/transitioned` events including the full resource to identify the customer.

## 2. Filter for payment
Only continues when payment is confirmed, indicating the transaction is complete.

## 3. Revoke transaction rights
Removes the customer's ability to initiate new transactions. They keep listing and read permissions.
